step.check: Checking the tools, the game file and the disks
phase.original.verify: Checking that the folder rebuilds the original exactly
phase.original.recycle: Moving the original to the Recycle Bin
state.unreadable: The build record {path} cannot be read.
state.newer_format: The build record {path} comes from a newer builder.
check.dest_not_empty: The game folder {path} is not empty and was not made by the builder: choose an empty folder.
check.game_missing: The game file {path} does not exist.
check.game_format: {name} is not an NSP or a NUP. The builder takes a decrypted (plaintext) .nsp or a .nup.
check.game_unreadable: {name} cannot be read as a decrypted NSP or a NUP ({detail}).
check.wrong_version: {name} is version {version}; the port needs version {expected}.
check.keys_missing: The keys file {path} does not exist.
check.firmware_missing: The firmware folder {path} holds no firmware files (.nca).
check.need_keys: The first build needs your prod.keys and a firmware folder, for the system fonts.
check.no_space: Not enough free space on {path}: {need_gib} GiB needed, {free_gib} GiB free.
check.vulkan: No Vulkan 1.3 driver found (found: {version}): the game may not start on this PC.
check.no_dlss: NVIDIA's DLSS library is not in the toolchains ({path}): the game will run without DLSS.
romfs.short_read: The game file {path} ended early: it may be damaged.
fonts.none: No system fonts were found in the firmware folder {firmware}.
shortcut.failed: The shortcut {path} could not be made.
original.no_hash: The original was not fingerprinted when the game files were copied: it is kept.
original.changed: The game file {path} changed since the build: it is kept.
original.not_recycled: {path} could not be moved to the Recycle Bin: it is kept.
restore.missing: The game folder {path} lacks the parts that rebuild the original (romfs/romfs.bin, original/rest.bin).
restore.mismatch: The game folder {path} does not rebuild the original exactly: its files changed.
check.restoring: The original {name} is not there (it went to the Recycle Bin): it is rebuilt from the game folder for this run, then removed.
phase.check.restore: Rebuilding the original game file from the game folder
check.tool_fetch: Missing tool: {what}. It can be downloaded: run again with --fetch-tools ({mb} MB in all).
tools.hash: {file} from {url} is not the file expected (its size or SHA-256 differs): it was not used.
tools.no_vulkan: No Vulkan on this PC ({path} is missing): install the graphics driver first.
tools.patch_failed: A fix of this port could not be applied to {file} ({detail}).
package.not_empty: The folder {path} is not empty and is not a package: choose an empty folder.
package.inside_repo: The package cannot be made inside the repository ({path}).
package.no_git: git could not list the files of the repository ({detail}).
romfs.bad_file: A file inside {path} does not match the hash recorded for it ({file}): the game file may be damaged.
original.nup_kept: {name} is kept: a NUP cannot be made again exactly from the game folder.
